answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 14 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in harbor, checked in nebula, and zephyr exposes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 3555 identities would post 4015 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
